thresholds.negativeOffscreenCentres: Both lower and upper viewport bounds are checked before indexing raster pixels.

standalone: The expanded full Tailwind/Preflight fixture passes check/dev/build --single and executes after removing source/configuration; includes all new utility families and actual gradient stops/keyframes.

focusedChecks.note: Scopes overlap; these counts are not added to consolidated totals. Scoped corrections and completion cover the final CSS inputs; the original full report remains failed.

consolidated.status: passed after scoped corrections and completion of unfinished suites

interruptedContinuation.cause: Obsolete assertion still required rotate(4deg) to be refused. Updated to accept rotation and refuse rotate(4px).

postAttemptCorrections: Skip zero-work tab-feature charging in standalone text measurement.
Mirror the clipped backdrop border-box image; resolve blur units through host metrics; huge radii use analytic mirror periods.
Emit all winning keyframe names in one traversal.
Update the obsolete rotate-refusal assertion to require rotate support and keep malformed-angle rejection.
Preserve ENGINE_STATES/ENGINE_INPUTS in generated Worker/DOM lexical module bindings.
The three failed system-font tests now pass in the completed desktop suite; no font or shaping budget was increased.

browserDelivery.generatedBundle: Actual Chrome trusted click/input, persistent closure state, DOM updates and denial behavior passed.
browserDelivery.bindingsRegression: Both generated lexical module variants execute against the actual Wasm engine.
browserDelivery.note: Studio input/click confirmed by the user-authorized peer through CDP/AX; closed shadow DOM explains why ordinary outer innerHTML appears empty.

limits: Direct GPU gradients/backdrop and grouped effects use explicit software presentation.
Atomic roots with unresolved placement/transform combinations are refused.
Pretty wrapping is a bounded best-effort UA strategy, not exact Chrome line choice.
Keyframe variables, custom/layout property animation, general matrix interpolation and some transformed samplers/scopes remain refused.
Broader CSS/Tailwind and full Firefox/WebKit/window/AT/GPU acceptance remain separate work.
